role: Declares RecordPanels, a non-View @MainActor struct that holds the record tab's observable state, derived flags, action closures and bindings so the large panel builders (in RecordView+Panels.swift) can live outside RecordView.
types: RecordPanels: struct (@MainActor, not a View) — collector, DeviceStatus, MorningCoordination, StreamingLifecycle, SessionState, SettingsManager, isActivelyRecording/isBatteryLow/isBatteryCritical, 10 action closures (incl. discardRecording(startOver) and discardPausedNight), 5 bindings (incl. showingDiscardConfirm), isDiscarding flag, BreathingAudioManager
toplevel: Only stored properties; memberwise init used by RecordView.panels (RecordView+PanelForwarding.swift) and UncoveredScreenSnapshotTests.panels(). No units in this file.
